title: Draft customer changelog templates with policy exceptions and signoff matrix
creator: Avery Park
description: Create a set of customer-facing changelog templates and a complementary policy for handling exceptions (security-sensitive redactions, embargoed features, regulated-customer notices). Deliverables: 3 tiered templates (Minor, Feature, Breaking), an exceptions decision flow, a signoff matrix mapping owners across PM/Legal/Security/Eng/Support/Communications, and a compact ops checklist for last-minute releases.
comments: 2025-02-18 — Avery Park: Initial ticket created after weekly GTM sync. Problem: engineers and comms teams are drafting ad-hoc changelogs; need consistent tone, redaction rules, and a faster signoff path for low-risk items. Reference: Confluence brief https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/LAUNCH/Changelog+Governance

2025-02-20 — Jordan Li: Scoped deliverables and proposed templates. Decided on 3 templates (Minor/Feature/Breaking) + an Exceptions Decision Flow doc. Added localization notes to avoid blocking non-English releases. Drafts uploaded to Google Doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-changelog-templates

2025-02-24 — Priya Menon (Legal): Quick review of redaction rules. Flagged two edge cases: (1) customer-identifying data exposures, (2) regulatory notices for Private customers. Requested explicit examples in the policy. Action: Legal to provide 3 example redactions by 2025-02-28.

2025-02-26 — Marcus Chen (Eng): Confirmed engineering can produce compact technical notes for Breaking changes. Raised concern: 'Breaking' classification will require release compatibility notes in docs; added dependency ENG-22013 for doc generation automation.

2025-03-01 — Jordan Li: Uploaded templates into the Console draft workflow and added metadata fields (severity, audience, embargo flag, localization-ready copy). Link to UX draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/console-changelog-ui-mock
2025-03-02 — Support (Lina Alvarez): Requested a 'Support playbook' snippet per template that includes expected customer queries and escalation contacts. Added to checklist under 'Support readiness'.

2025-03-03 — Communications (Ben Ortiz): Reviewed tone and suggested shorter summaries for in-product banners. Proposed 1-line TL;DR plus 2-sentence expansion for docs. Agreed to a single-sentence headline limit of 120 chars.

2025-03-04 — Jordan Li: Incorporated Legal examples into Exceptions Decision Flow. Updated signoff matrix draft and assigned primary owners: PM owner (Jordan Li), Legal reviewer (Priya Menon), Security (TBD), Eng owner (Marcus Chen), Support (Lina Alvarez), Comms (Ben Ortiz). Next: schedule 30m stakeholder bakeoff on 2025-03-06 to finalize SLA for signoff timing.

Acceptance criteria — Templates available in Drive, policy with 5 example redactions, signoff matrix agreed, localization-ready strings, and an ops checklist that reduces average signoff time for Minor changes to <24 hours.
